change: Atomic local capture and provenance-aware source queries
milestone_status: M0-M2 and M3.1 complete; M3.2 next; full M3 runtime scenarios pending

checks.scope: Full suite, generated schema equality and documentation checks
Locked source install, full suite, fresh-cache tarball consumer, public exports, installed CLI create/verify/capture/update/replay/search/history/exact revisions/context

checks.command: Read-only existing foundation context via library and Spanish CLI
checks.scope: Original request/plan/manifest, matching context and byte/listing comparisons; no private data writes or ingestion

mechanisms: BEGIN IMMEDIATE atomically commits source, project link, pending capture and histories; injected final-write failures roll back creation and updates
Instance/actor request keys replay exact original source/project/locator/content; changed payloads or destinations conflict
Conditional source updates prevent stale replacement; concurrent requests commit one capture or one updated revision
Exact UTF-8 body/hash preserves BOM, CRLF and trailing newlines; bounded regular-file reads reject invalid encoding, NUL, blank, FIFO and oversized inputs
SQL applies instance, project and source access before literal matching and pagination; current ACL revocation protects historical retrieval
Read-only context/search/source/history preserve database bytes and directory entries; context omits unrestricted raw project reference lists
Actual process exits leave hot/cold SQLite journals; queries fail closed, explicit authorized recovery restores logical state without duplicate records
Unverified source text creates no claims, decisions, grants or actions; pending captures are not integrated workflow outcomes
English repository and help coexist with scoped Spanish localization; flag-looking input is preserved as source data

acceptance_scope.A19: passed for local knowledge API: instance/project/source scopes, current ACLs, matching and pagination; future runtime/tool boundaries remain pending
acceptance_scope.A03_A05_A18: source-only prerequisites tested; full decision-aware, temporal and real-runtime scenarios not_run
acceptance_scope.A08_A21: capture transactions/retries tested; coordinator fencing and external effects not_run
acceptance_scope.A27: existing harness tests retained; runtime evaluator integration not_run

verification_findings_resolved: Initialized SQLite connections previously rewrote the database header; new connections now initialize only new stores, preserving bytes on exact replay
Removing implicit header writes exposed cold interrupted journals; explicit recovery now finalizes them through SQLite after checking the recorded request, preserving logical revisions
limitations: Trusted local owner CLI; no remote authentication or model/tool sandbox
Only explicit text and regular UTF-8 files up to 1 MiB; no PDF/Word parser, folder import, watcher, remote fetch or automatic private-source ingestion
Literal case-sensitive search over current accessible source segments; no ranking, embeddings, temporal fact interpretation or decision-aware summaries
Each read is a coherent snapshot; separate pages may observe later writes
Current project/source ACLs protect retrieval; separate ACL records do not cascade changes automatically
Source observation time describes the snapshot, not when an underlying statement became true
M2 construction grants, catalog versions, manifest profile and original plan digests are unchanged; M3.1 does not activate runtime workflows
No decision promotion, artifact workflow, durable coordinator, distributed fencing or external effect delivery
Malicious-source storage test is not a real-runtime prompt-injection evaluation
Local evidence is macOS arm64; exact-commit GitHub Actions reports its own environment
node:sqlite remains experimental in the pinned Node version
source_hash_scope: Executable, tooling, tests and package configuration at M3.1; documentation and examples are inventoried separately by package-manifest.json
